header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: each one is the governor of some city. I seek Allah's protection from becoming great in my own eyes and small in the sight of Allah. The method of Nubuwwah (prophethood) keeps vanishing. The method of kingship has seized that place; very soon you will gain experience through the other governors who come after us!’ he said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The special feature of the prophetic method is that it establishes justice and integrity, and stirs up detachment from the world and longing for the Hereafter; such qualities are generally not found in the method of kingship.
(Takmila Fath al-Mulhim)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ كُلَّمَا كَانَ لَيْلَتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ إِلَي الْبَقِيعِ فَيَقُولُ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ، وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، اللهُمَّ! اغْفِرْ لِأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب مايقال عند دخول القبور......، رقم:٢٢٥٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates: “Whenever the Prophet ﷺ came to my house on the day when it was my turn for the Prophet ﷺ to stay with me, he would get up in the latter part of the night, go to the graveyard (Jannat al-Baqi'), and recite the Du'a (السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ، وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ) “O residents of the abode of the Muslims! Assalamu Alaikum; the day of death that was promised to you has come to you, and Insha Allah we too are going to join you; O Allah, forgive the people of Baqi'!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُسْتَوْرِدِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ ﵁ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: وَاللهِ مَا الدُّنْيَا فِي اْلآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مِثْلُ مَا يَجْعَلُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِصْبَعَهُ هذِهِ فِي الْيَمِّ
